first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A low-slung blue open-wheel single-seat race car with white wing surfaces and trim and exposed black tires; a white number 6 is visible on the nose cone in frame 0.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A red open-wheel single-seat race car following behind Vehicle A, with yellow longitudinal trim on both sides of the cockpit and predominantly black front wings and tires.

entities.name: gray asphalt racetrack
entities.identification: A broad gray paved racetrack with a visible white edge line and band-like surface marks of varying shades.

entities.name: grass shoulder
entities.identification: A continuous green and yellow-green grassy area beside the blue-and-white segmented curb.

entities.name: metal guardrail
entities.identification: Silver-gray parallel metal beams partially visible on the far side of the grass.

entities.name: blue-and-white segmented curb
entities.identification: A narrow strip-like curb laid along the edge of the racetrack and composed of alternating blue and white blocks.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person seated in Vehicle A's open cockpit, wearing a light-colored helmet and a dark visor, with most of the body occluded by the vehicle body.

entities.name: gray rectangular upright panel
entities.identification: A gray-blue rectangular upright panel on the grass at image-right in the opening view, with its right portion cropped by the frame.

entities.name: orange raised curb strip
entities.identification: An orange, narrow, elongated raised strip on the grass side of the blue-and-white segmented curb at the inside of the bend.

entities.name: orange block at the end of the guardrail
entities.identification: An orange block-like facility adjacent to the end of the metal guardrail.
